item.title: PHOTOS: Milan 2026 Winter Olympics Closing Ceremony
item.description: After weeks of athletic feats, the 2026 Milan Winter Olympics come to an end on Sunday, Feb. 22, 2026, during the Closing Ceremony at Verona Arena in Verona, Italy.

item.title: Mets’ Jorge Polanco working on footwork – and ready to do the splits – as he transitions to 1B
item.description: As a career middle infielder, Jorge Polanco can field ground balls with ease, is feeling good about his footwork around the first base bag, and is getting comfortable with making tough picks.

item.title: 2 people killed, 7 wounded in Richmond, Va., shooting
item.description: Genesis Jones, 23, and Dominic Jackson, 42, were killed in the shooting early Saturday morning.

item.title: Fourth-quarter drought sinks Nets in loss to Hawks
item.description: The Nets fell to the Atlanta Hawks 115-104 Sunday afternoon at State Farm Arena, dropping to 15-41 and extending their losing streak to four games.

item.title: Trump says hospital ship en route to Greenland, which says it doesn’t need it
item.description: Greenland found itself fending off yet another attempt by the Trump administration to override its sovereignty this week, graciously declining the U.S. president’s offer to send a hospital ship its way.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns erupts for 28 points as Knicks beat Bulls, 105-99
item.description: Karl-Anthony Towns is in rhythm — and the Knicks are back in the win column.

item.title: Eric Dane’s posthumous tender words about wife Rebecca Gayheart
item.description: The actor Eric Dane shared tender words about estranged wife Rebecca Gayheart in one of the final interviews he gave before dying last week of Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis at age 53.

item.title: Tourette’s syndrome advocate blurts out profanity, racial epithet at BAFTAs
item.description: Some awkward moments ensued at the British BAFTA awards on Sunday as Tourette’s syndrome advocate John Davidson blurted out random profanities and a racial epithet during the ceremony, whose audience included the Prince and Princess of Wales.

item.title: Asking Eric: Adult daughter’s job struggles keep mother from finding happiness
